import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load Field Expenses
df_fe_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
header_idx = df_fe_raw[df_fe_raw[0]=='Transaction ID'].index[0]
df_fe = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=header_idx)

# Load Salary Register
df_sal_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
header_idx_sal = df_sal_raw[df_sal_raw[0]=='Payroll Line ID'].index[0]
df_sal = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=header_idx_sal)

# Load Cost Centre Lookup
df_cc_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
header_idx_cc = df_cc_raw[df_cc_raw[0]=='Cost Centre Code'].index[0]
df_cc = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=header_idx_cc)

# Normalize cost centre codes
def normalize_code(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ''
    return str(x).strip().lower()

df_fe['cost_norm'] = df_fe['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
df_sal['cost_norm'] = df_sal['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
df_cc['cost_norm'] = df_cc['Cost Centre Code'].apply(normalize_code)

# Prepare lookup
lookup = df_cc[['cost_norm','Programme','District','State','Primary Funder']].drop_duplicates()

# Filter Field Expenses
df_fe['trans_id'] = df_fe['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
df_fe['posting_status_norm'] = df_fe['Posting Status'].apply(normalize_code)
fe_filter = (
    df_fe['trans_id'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (df_fe['posting_status_norm'] == 'posted')
)
df_fe_filt = df_fe[fe_filter].copy()

# Filter Salary
df_sal['payroll_line_id'] = df_sal['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
df_sal['payroll_status_norm'] = df_sal['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize_code)
sal_filter = (
    df_sal['payroll_line_id'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (df_sal['payroll_status_norm'] == 'paid')
)
df_sal_filt = df_sal[sal_filter].copy()

# Merge with lookup
fe_merged = df_fe_filt.merge(lookup, on='cost_norm', how='inner')
sal_merged = df_sal_filt.merge(lookup, on='cost_norm', how='inner')

# Filter for Maternal and Child Health in Odisha
# Programme exact match? Assume case-insensitive?
def normalize_text(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ''
    return str(x).strip().lower()

fe_merged['prog_norm'] = fe_merged['Programme'].apply(normalize_text)
fe_merged['state_norm'] = fe_merged['State'].apply(normalize_text)
sal_merged['prog_norm'] = sal_merged['Programme'].apply(normalize_text)
sal_merged['state_norm'] = sal_merged['State'].apply(normalize_text)

fe_target = fe_merged[
    (fe_merged['prog_norm'] == 'maternal and child health') &
    (fe_merged['state_norm'] == 'odisha')
]
sal_target = sal_merged[
    (sal_merged['prog_norm'] == 'maternal and child health') &
    (sal_merged['state_norm'] == 'odisha')
]

fe_sum = fe_target['Amount (INR)'].sum()
sal_sum = sal_target['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
combined = fe_sum + sal_sum

print("Field expenses rows after filter:", len(fe_target))
print("Salary rows after filter:", len(sal_target))
print("Field sum:", fe_sum)
print("Salary sum:", sal_sum)
print("Combined:", combined)

# Also show distinct cost centres
print("Field cost centres used:", fe_target['Cost Centre'].unique())
print("Salary cost centres used:", sal_target['Cost Centre'].unique())

import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

def load_sheet_with_header(sheet_name, header_marker):
    raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=None)
    # find header row where first column equals marker
    idx = None
    for i, row in raw.iterrows():
        if str(row[0]).strip() == header_marker:
            idx = i
            break
    if idx is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Header {header_marker} not found in {sheet_name}")
    df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name=sheet_name, header=idx)
    return df

df_fe = load_sheet_with_header('Field Expenses', 'Transaction ID')
df_sal = load_sheet_with_header('Salary Register', 'Payroll Line ID')
df_cc = load_sheet_with_header('Cost Centre Lookup', 'Cost Centre Code')

def normalize_code(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ''
    return str(x).strip().lower()

def normalize_text(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ''
    return str(x).strip().lower()

def clean_amount(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return None
    s = str(val).strip()
    # Remove rupee symbol and commas
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','')
    # Keep digits only
    digits = ''.join(ch for ch in s if ch.isdigit())
    if digits == '':
        return None
    return int(digits)

# Clean amounts
df_fe['amount_clean'] = df_fe['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)
df_sal['gross_clean'] = df_sal['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

# Normalize cost centres
df_fe['cost_norm'] = df_fe['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
df_sal['cost_norm'] = df_sal['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
df_cc['cost_norm'] = df_cc['Cost Centre Code'].apply(normalize_code)

# Normalize statuses
df_fe['posting_status_norm'] = df_fe['Posting Status'].apply(normalize_text)
df_sal['payroll_status_norm'] = df_sal['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize_text)

# Normalize IDs
df_fe['trans_id'] = df_fe['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
df_sal['payroll_line_id'] = df_sal['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Prepare lookup
lookup = df_cc[['cost_norm','Programme','District','State','Primary Funder']].copy()
lookup['prog_norm'] = lookup['Programme'].apply(normalize_text)
lookup['state_norm'] = lookup['State'].apply(normalize_text)

# Filter field expenses
fe_filter = (
    df_fe['trans_id'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (df_fe['posting_status_norm'] == 'posted') &
    df_fe['amount_clean'].notna()
)
df_fe_filt = df_fe[fe_filter].copy()

# Filter salary
sal_filter = (
    df_sal['payroll_line_id'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (df_sal['payroll_status_norm'] == 'paid') &
    df_sal['gross_clean'].notna()
)
df_sal_filt = df_sal[sal_filter].copy()

# Merge with lookup (inner join ensures code exists in lookup)
fe_merged = df_fe_filt.merge(lookup, on='cost_norm', how='inner', suffixes=('','_lookup'))
sal_merged = df_sal_filt.merge(lookup, on='cost_norm', how='inner', suffixes=('','_lookup'))

# Target: Programme = Maternal and Child Health, State = Odisha
target_prog = 'maternal and child health'
target_state = 'odisha'

fe_target = fe_merged[
    (fe_merged['prog_norm'] == target_prog) &
    (fe_merged['state_norm'] == target_state)
]
sal_target = sal_merged[
    (sal_merged['prog_norm'] == target_prog) &
    (sal_merged['state_norm'] == target_state)
]

fe_sum = fe_target['amount_clean'].sum()
sal_sum = sal_target['gross_clean'].sum()
combined = fe_sum + sal_sum

print("Field expense rows eligible:", len(fe_target))
print("Salary rows eligible:", len(sal_target))
print("Field sum:", fe_sum)
print("Salary sum:", sal_sum)
print("Combined sum:", combined)

# Debug distinct cost centres
print("Field cost centres (original):", fe_target['Cost Centre'].unique().tolist())
print("Salary cost centres (original):", sal_target['Cost Centre'].unique().tolist())
print("Lookup cost centres for MCH Odisha:")
mch_od = lookup[(lookup['prog_norm']==target_prog) & (lookup['state_norm']==target_state)]
print(mch_od[['cost_norm','Programme','District','State']].to_string(index=False))
